entities.summary: Edward Voigt was a German American immigrant, lawyer, and Republican politician from Sheboygan, Wisconsin. He served five terms in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 2nd congressional district from 1917 to 1927. He previously served as city attorney of Sheboygan and district attorney of Sheboygan County.
